design_philosophy: Tactical Command Center. High-density, high-contrast, technical, and stable. Rejects the soft 'SaaS' aesthetic in favor of a hard-edged, data-first terminal vibe with stark structural greys and vivid kinetic trigger colors (Volt Yellow & Neon Cyan) to signify a powerful, real-time bot fleet control system.

primary_heading.description: Used for all panel headers, bot names, global stat numbers, and primary UI navigation.
primary_heading.weight_usage: SemiBold (600) for standard headers, Black (900) tracking-tight for massive stat counters.

secondary_body_data.description: Used for ALL dynamic data: console logs, stats, IP:ports, shard counts, form inputs, and status labels. Enhances the technical/terminal aesthetic.
secondary_body_data.weight_usage: Regular (400) for body, Bold (700) for active statuses.

usage_rules.background: Never use pure black. Use --bg-void for the main app background, --bg-surface for cards/tiles.
usage_rules.kinetic_accent: Use --brand-kinetic sparingly for active states, selected tabs, and primary CTAs. It should pop aggressively against the dark background.

visual_enhancers.borders: Strictly 1px solid --border-dim. No soft muddy shadows. Use sharp or very slightly rounded corners (border-radius: 4px for inputs, 8px for cards).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY for fixed/sticky headers, the mobile bottom nav bar, and the Command Palette overlay. Requires backdrop-filter: blur(12px) and a 1px inner top border.

layouts.app_shell: CSS Grid layout. Desktop: Left sidebar (icon nav) + Main content area. Mobile: Top header (global stats) + Main content + Fixed Bottom Navigation Bar.
layouts.fleet_grid: Bento-style CSS Grid. Responsive: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(280px, 1fr)). Gap: 16px (Dense mode: 8px).
layouts.inventory_grid: Minecraft-accurate proportions. grid-template-columns: repeat(9, 1fr). Each slot is aspect-ratio 1/1, bg-surface-hover, inset shadow.
layouts.detail_panel: Split view or modal overlay for Bot Details. Top: Tab strip. Bottom: Content area. Console tab must fill available vertical space with overflow-y-auto.

bot_tile.structure: Header (Drag Handle, Name, Status Dot), Body (Monospace stats: Uptime, Shards, Host), Footer (Start/Stop/Restart tiny icon buttons).
bot_tile.interaction: Hover: border changes to --border-focus, slight transform translateY(-1px). Dragging state: opacity 0.8, glowing border.
bot_tile.status_dot: 8x8px circle. Online: box-shadow glow. Offline: muted red, no glow.

console_terminal.style: Font: JetBrains Mono. Background: #000000. Text: #CCCCCC. Padding: 16px. Custom scrollbar (2px wide, kinetic color thumb). Log levels colorized (INFO: cyan, WARN: yellow, ERR: red).

command_palette.style: Fixed inset-0, z-index: 100. Background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6) backdrop-blur-md. Center modal: 600px wide, 1px border --border-focus, box-shadow ambient. Input: massive text, no border, JetBrains Mono.

mobile_bottom_nav.style: Fixed bottom-0, w-full, z-index: 50. background: var(--glass-bg), backdrop-filter: blur(16px), border-top: 1px solid var(--glass-border). Flex space-around, padding 12px. Phosphor icons.

mass_command_runner.style: A command strip fixed at the top of the Commands page. Input field + Target selector (All/Category) + 'Execute' button with a Volt Yellow background and black text for stark contrast.

motion.transitions: Never use 'transition: all'. Use specific properties. e.g., 'transition: border-color 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease'.
motion.drag_drop: Use SortableJS animation option (animation: 150) for fluid reordering.

instructions_to_main_agent: STRICT CONSTRAINT: Build this as a SINGLE-FILE vanilla HTML app (multibot.html). ALL CSS goes in <style>, ALL JS in <script> at the bottom.
NO REACT, NO VUE, NO BUILD STEPS. Vanilla JS DOM manipulation only.
Implement the tile drag-and-drop reordering using SortableJS (linked via CDN) and save the layout array to localStorage.
For Real-Time updates (SSE), implement a mock EventSource in vanilla JS that randomly updates bot tile stats and console logs every few seconds to simulate live data.
Implement the Command Palette (Ctrl+K) using a vanilla JS event listener on document keydown.
Build the UI Mobile-First. The bottom navigation bar MUST only appear on screens < 768px, hiding the desktop sidebar.
Minecraft Inventory Grid must be accurately rendered (9 columns, 3 rows for main, 1 row for hotbar separated by a margin).

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: MANDATORY: Add data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='bot-tile-1', data-testid='cmd-palette-input', data-testid='start-bot-btn').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text against --bg-surface meets 4.5:1 ratio. --text-muted should only be used for non-essential visual labels.

universal_guidelines: Avoid generic centered layouts. Left-align data for scannability.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Never use emoji characters (🤖, etc.) for UI icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers. Use --glass-bg with backdrop-filter.
